title: Profile
description: Who you are. Drives the landing page (name, role, location, summary) plus the footer repo link, the PWA name and the page title.

firstName.description: First / given names, shown large on the landing page.

lastName.description: Family name, shown in outline under the first name.

title.description: Current role, shown as the first tag and in the page title. Keep it the same as your current job in experience.json.

avatarGreeting.description: What your avatar says when a visitor opens it.

summary.description: Short bio (one or two lines), shown on the landing page and in the page description.

about.description:
Long bio, shown in the About section. Blank lines (

) separate paragraphs. Write {years} for your years of experience (worked out from careerStart).

resumeSummary.description: Summary paragraph at the top of the downloadable resume. Write {years} for your years of experience (worked out from careerStart).

careerStart.description: Date you started working (YYYY-MM-DD). Used to compute years of experience.

repoUrl.description: Link to this site's source code, shown in the footer.

resumeName.description: Name as printed on the resume, e.g. "Akhil Nadh PC". Defaults to firstName + lastName.

headline.description: Resume headline under your name, e.g. "Senior Data Scientist | Gen AI". Defaults to title.

hometown.description: Where you are from, if different from location. Shown in About.

achievements.description: Awards and recognition. Shown in About and on the resume.
